summary: Contestants will answer objective questions to demonstrate their knowledge of medical front office procedures, healthcare system structure, patient communication and scheduling, regulatory and ethical standards, billing and insurance processes, and management of patient records and office documentation. The event is open to any secondary or postsecondary division contestant. The competition consists of a timed test with no reference materials allowed.
time_limits: no more than ten (10) minutes orientation
no more than sixty (60) minutes testing time
no more than ten (10) minutes wrap-up
what_to_bring: (Optional) Cordless calculator: Electronic devices will be monitored according to ACT standards. See NLC Calculator Guidelines. Contestants who violate this rule will be disqualified.
competencies: Demonstrate understanding of medical office roles, healthcare delivery settings, and organizational structures
Apply knowledge of effective patient interaction, appointment scheduling, and front office workflow procedures
Understand and apply HIPAA, patient confidentiality, and ethical guidelines in medical office operations
Demonstrate knowledge of insurance verification, claims processing, payment collection, and general revenue cycle concepts
Apply proper procedures for organizing, maintaining, and safeguarding patient records and office documentation
judging_notes: Reference materials are not allowed. Contestants who violate this rule will be disqualified.
AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed
eligibility_notes: Any secondary or postsecondary division contestant may enter this objective event.
